$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for census/naics_2017_to_2022, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the six-digit `pattern` on from_code and to_code, the shape descriptor.overrides.json publishes; the closed `enum` on from_edition, to_edition and release; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the titles. NOT ENFORCED, by design: NULLs (invisible to ft_validate) and object-level `required` (documentation only); the edition crosswalk contract in ../../contracts/check_crosswalk.sql refuses a NULL code, edition or release. Free-text fields carry LOOSE length envelopes with headroom. Derived from build/stage/naics_2017_to_2022.parquet on Census's files of 2026-11-17: a pass-through on today's rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (a code that is not six digits, another edition, a release other than the edition).
title: census/naics_2017_to_2022
